kjv: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call (KJV 20:9)
mine: O Yahweh, save the king! May he answer us when we call
note: MT yhwh hoshi'ah hammelekh ya'anenu can be divided "save, O Yahweh; may the King (God) answer us" (KJV) or "save the king; may he answer us" (LXX); the KJV's "hear" for ya'aneh is close enough.
